newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Technical fault keeps Singapore share trading shut.
newsitem.headline: Technical fault keeps Singapore share trading shut.

text.p: Trading at the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) remained stalled at midday on Monday due to a technical glitch, an exchange official said.
"We are still trying to get the system going as soon as possible," a SES spokeswoman told Reuters.
The cause of the fault remained unknown.
Some dealers told Reuters they were taking the opportunity to watch the Malaysian stock market and spend time chatting with clients.
